exit 0
--- stdout
Report provider token usage recorded by Liza supervisors.
Records are joined to durable task history when the report is built, so the
same records read at a later time reflect later lifecycle events.
Examples:
liza usage report --json
Usage:
liza usage [command]
Available Commands:
report Attribute provider usage to terminal task outcomes
Flags:
-h, --help help for usage
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
Use "liza usage [command] --help" for more information about a command.
--- stderr
